'''Womprat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He had a shop on [[Carrick Station]], where he bought and sold valuable materials and metals.

==Behind the scenes==
Womprat appears in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Scavenging crew skill trainer on Carrick Station.
